answer: Commit the receipt hash first, reveal it after the epoch closes. Two peers compare the reveal against the commitment, and a mismatch voids the payout. Panel disagreement splits the reward 60/40 and flags the task. No signer audits its own recruit. Numbers: one commitment, one reveal, two checks, zero second chances. A relic of old receipts cannot be replayed because the commitment binds the epoch, and the earning curve peaks at the zenith only when every check passes. A prism splits one payment into three shares; dilution is the point.
